title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(河原大研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Kawahara Hiro)
educationalGoal: The objective of the project is to discover issues related to wood-based materials and timber structures in light of the social background, and to gain new knowledge by collecting, evaluating, and analyzing information. The learning outcomes will be confirmed by compiling the obtained findings into a report and making a presentation.
advice: [Previous term] Acquisition of basic knowledge / Project setting / Project execution 1) Learn the basic knowledge of each participant's area of activity. 2) Receive guidance on the appropriateness of their chosen theme for Project Design III through reports in the Plenary Seminar and complete their project proposals. 3) Conduct field surveys, structural experiments, structural analysis, and structural design according to each own project proposal. 4) Present and report the results of the first semester [Latter term] Project Implementation / Summary of Project Outcomes 1) Based on the feedback from the presentation of the results of the first semester, continue to conduct field surveys, structural experiments, structural analysis, and structural design. 2) Present the progress results at the interim presentation in the field of building structure. 3) Summarize the results of the entire project and submit a project report. 4) The contents of the project report will be presented at the public presentation review meeting of Project Design III.
requiredKnowledge: It is necessary to acquire content related to structural mechanics for architecture, building materials, and structural experiments. On the premise of contributing to society, you should be aware of the SDGs and try to gather information for community cooperation on a daily basis.

activityGoals.body: You are able to identify social conditions, discover problems, and imagine ideal conditions.
You are able to conduct the necessary research, experiments, and analyses on a topic of your own choosing.
You are able to summarize the results from your investigations, experiments, and analyses in a project report.
You are able to present the contents of the project report in a logical manner.
You are able to identify and develop your own career path and move forward without regrets as a career path.
